sheets.prompt: Create a SQUARE illustration sprite atlas for a German reading app for children ages 5-7. EXACTLY a regular 4 by 4 grid of 16 equal square cells, no lines between cells, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermarks. Each cell contains ONE single large clearly recognisable object centered fully inside its own cell with generous 15% blank padding. Pure uniform warm off-white background #fffdf8 throughout. Style: beautiful modern children's picture-book spot illustrations, simple clean silhouettes, slightly rounded shapes, warm natural colours, subtle soft shading and a very light paper texture, neat expressive but not wobbly outlines, friendly high-quality professional educational art, not photorealistic, not crude geometric icons, no faces on inanimate objects. All items have consistent viewpoint/style, clearly readable at 100px. STRICT row-major contents: Row1: (1) a comfortable green two-seat sofa with cushions, (2) one beige llama with long upright neck and wool, (3) a piece of salami sausage with a clearly visible pink cut face and several round slices, (4) one ripe red tomato with green leafy top. Row2: (1) one yellow banana, (2) a cut melon with green rind and orange flesh and seeds, (3) one small brown hedgehog with recognisable spines, (4) one grey donkey with long ears. Row3: (1) ONE curved hollow macaroni pasta tube, very clearly a noodle rather than a worm or snake, (2) one brown rabbit with long ears and fluffy tail, (3) one pair of blue trousers, (4) one fresh green lettuce head. Row4: (1) one cosy single bed with pillow and blanket, (2) one wooden hair comb with teeth, (3) one ceramic drinking cup with handle, no tea bag and no steam, (4) one ceramic pouring pot with spout and handle. Keep all 16 items separate and entirely within their corresponding cell. Exact equal grid alignment is essential for software use.
